verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly is a SaaS platform with AI features (AI Runs, LLM-as-a-judge evals, AgentControl configs), so a data-training opt-out or no-training commitment is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no documentation of any such policy or control. Adjacent compliance material such as the FedRAMP instance does not address AI training use and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
